_doc: Ocean Whisperer (Curaçao-core) economic-corridor SOURCE block for finance/model/corridors.json. Tasklet authors the enumerated legs + cost inputs + demand basis + modeled fare records; GROK seals route_id / from_node_id / to_node_id / distance_nm_verified / geom_verdict / shippable against the Atlas graph FIRST, THEN the economics cascade runs on the sealed IDs. Until then every corridor carries route_id:null and _status:PENDING_SEAL. broad-footprint-first, exact-bind-second; null beats confidently-wrong.
_lane: Tasklet = corridors+demand+fares(modeled)+country-ref+BP+narrative. Grok = seal geometry, then cascade economics, then sidecar. Do NOT hand-type the growth ladder.
_shared_network_note: Curaçao is a SHARED node (golden rule #4 — shared network, scoped view, never copied). The same Curaçao geometry also feeds the generic 'caribbean' (Caribbean x Navier) proposal as part of the ABC trio. Ocean Whisperer is the CAPTIVE-LUXURY SCOPED VIEW of Curaçao (Sandals/Baoase/Piscadera resort mesh + cruise feed + Klein Curaçao seasonal). Grok should bind via scoped view, not duplicate corridors.

market.label: Ocean Whisperer — Curaçao (captive-luxury resort + cruise mesh)
market._fleet_basis_note: Leeward (south/west) Curaçao = captive resort-transfer mesh anchored on Sandals Royal Curaçao + Baoase + Piscadera + cruise feed; Klein Curaçao = seasonal amber excursion; Bonaire/Aruba = Quanta-LR roadmap network legs (the standardization/scale story, never grounded on a 70nm boat).
market._capture_note: Captive ~55% (per Jaideep 24-Jun). NOT FP's ~90% — Curaçao retains ~45% headroom, so the cascade ladder MUST rise (SOM below SAM/TAM); do NOT flat-line to floor like FP. See OCEAN-WHISPERER-FINE-TUNING.md §0.
market._capex_note: Dedicated hospitality-partner proposal → $1M/vessel hospitality tier (region-independent, overrides the $900K Caribbean commercial tier). Scope (a), locked 24-Jun. The generic caribbean.json stays $900K commercial — keep tiers distinct.
market._greenfield: Curaçao has no own census → cascade uses the labelled global template band (3.44/4.9/6.36), never a peer census file.
